exposure: Gestational diabetes mellitus (GDM) during first pregnancy
cohort: 128 women who delivered two sequential live singleton infants and were diagnosed with diet-treated GDM during their first pregnancies
finding: The recurrence rate of GDM was high (43.75%) and was associated with older age at second pregnancy, higher weight gain during pregnancy, shorter interpregnancy interval, and macrosomia during the first pregnancy.
mod_finding: Women with recurrent gestational diabetes mellitus were more likely to have a caesarean section during their second pregnancy compared to their first pregnancy.
